description: This file defines Gradle build logic for Android app variants, including tasks for generating and checking app badging information, with classes GenerateBadgingTask and CheckBadgingTask, and a function to configure these tasks per variant.

classes.name: GenerateBadgingTask
classes.description: A Gradle task that generates badging information for an Android app using aapt2.

classes.name: CheckBadgingTask
classes.description: A Gradle task that compares generated badging info with a golden file to verify correctness.

methods.description: Executes the aapt2 dump badging command and writes output to a file.

methods.name: taskAction
methods.description: Compares generated badging with golden badging to ensure they are equal.
